Florina – Elegant High Contrast Serif Font

Add a sophisticated, elegant, and fashion-forward touch to your creative projects with Florina, a striking high-contrast serif display font.

Florina combines dramatic thick-and-thin strokes with distinctive, graceful letterforms, creating a refined editorial aesthetic. Its elegant appearance makes it especially suitable for luxury branding, fashion designs, editorial layouts, invitations, and stylish typography projects.
